elements.name: title
elements.text: Evidence for reuse, with precise limits

elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Compatibility is a versioned integration result, not a promise inferred from an API name.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Pinned source review: SDK 9e339019; upstream JiuwenSwarm 02b37f47. Sources and URLs are in notes.

Reference	What exists / what remains ours
JiuwenSwarm skills and evolution	Native skill library, scoped visibility, tool/MCP bindings and creation/evolution hooks. CC packaging and research qualification remain ours.
JiuwenBox lifecycle and tool runtime	Process sandbox APIs, job controls and inference forwarding. Bubblewrap remains distinct from OCI packaging and whole-VM control.
SDK launcher and release defaults	Base pause/resume/delete may be no-ops. Default release can delete. Actual backend stop and lab preservation need tests.
Model serving and routing	vLLM serves models; JiuwenBox proxies requests; LiteLLM maps aliases. Our feature checks, scoped routing and invocation pins need validation.
Anthropic, April 8, 2026	Stable state/execution interfaces motivate replaceable implementations. This is precedent, not an AI4R evaluation.

elements.name: takeaway text
elements.text: Compatibility enables contributions upstream. Qualification and upstream acceptance remain separate.
